units.source_text: "现在回想起来，这桩不幸的恋爱，可能是由于我的不幸的心灵造成的。

en.t: Looking back on it now, this unhappy love affair may have been caused by my own unhappy heart.

units.source_text: 我天生拥有一颗灰暗的心。

en.t: I was born with a gloomy heart.

units.source_text: 我的心似乎未曾懂得悠然的开朗。"

en.t: My heart seemed never to have known an easy, carefree brightness.
